Run A:

```bash
mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"
gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
gh pr view 101 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git remote get-url origin
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

**Set routing.** There are two PR tokens, so the run follows `reference/batch.md`.

**Admission ran before any command, with no effects.**
- Neither token is a positional issue reference.
- 112 and 101 are distinct identities.
- There are no URLs to compare against origin.
- The set size of 2 is within `parallel.maxTasks` 4.
- The harness is pi.
- This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed.

**Commands, in the order of the block above:**
1. Mint the parent RUN_DIR from the session checkout.
2. Gather each token unchanged, in typed order.
3. Read the viewer login (`alex`) and teams (`acme/reviewers`) once each.
4. Resolve origin (`acme/widgets`) and read the tracker settings from origin's default branch. None of the override files exists, so there is no tracker override.

**Ticket display:**
- #112's closing reference is in `acme/widgets`, which matches origin, so it is labeled `#22`.
- #101 has no closing reference. Its branch `gh-45-retry` yields `gh-45`, which links to origin's issue 45.

**Why each PR is listed:**
- #112: the author is pat and no review is requested, so the entry reads `by pat`.
- #101: the author equals the viewer, so the entry reads `yours`.

The list follows as its own message, with no marker and nothing awaited:

PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---

**Next step:** serial provisioning per `reference/batch.md` `## Provision serially`. It starts with one `git fetch origin` and then provisions in roster order (112, then 101). There is no `--rebase`, so no confirmation question is asked.

Run B:
```bash
mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=gadgets -F n=97
gh repo view acme/gadgets --json nameWithOwner
gh pr diff 97 -R acme/gadgets
gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate
gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/gadgets/issues/97/comments --paginate
git worktree list --porcelain
git remote get-url origin
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

**Set routing.** There is one typed token, so the run follows the single-PR path. Section A is already in context and is not re-read.

**Start of the run.**
- Mint the run folder.
- Initialize its continuation record.
- Run `plan_tracker` `init` with `gather, provision, verify`; there is no `--rebase`, so there is no `sync` stage.

**Gather.**
- The first view uses the bare token, so it resolves through gh's default repository. It returns `https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97`.
- Every later call therefore takes `acme/gadgets` from that URL. The number-only `gh pr diff` call gets `-R acme/gadgets`.
- No reviewer placeholder or reviewer workflow appears, so no `gh run view` or reviewer `gh run list` call runs.
- `git worktree list --porcelain` only discovers worktrees; none exists.

**Ticket display.**
- Origin resolves to `acme/widgets`, but the closing reference is in `acme/gadgets`. The label is therefore `acme/gadgets#45`, linked to that reference's own URL.
- The override reads find no files, so Linear stays allowed, but rule 1 already matched and no lookup runs.

**Why the PR is listed.** The pending User request names `alex`, so the entry reads `by robin, requested from you`.

The list follows as its own message, with no marker and nothing awaited:

---
PR to gate:
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, [acme/gadgets#45](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/issues/45) - add a CSV export button to the widget list
---
Paired call: none

**Next step:** step 2, Provision + configure (`reference/assessment.md`).
